name: Viscer Nursing III
summary:
VisceR Nursing III is an immersive VR clinical training experience designed for nursing students and healthcare learners. The pack focuses on Cardiology, Emergency Response, Advanced Nursing and IV & Injections, allowing learners to practice procedures in a safe, repeatable, risk-free virtual environment.

Emergency Response
• AED
• Oxygen Mask
IV & Injections
• IV Cannulation
• IV Setup & Infusion
• IV Injection Administration
• Intradermal Injection
• Intramuscular Injection
• Subcutaneous Injection
Advan
